failures.intro: The handler uses a `player` variable that it does not declare: the variable of the connection function (node/server.js:4989-4991). Only a socket that connected with a `secret` query sets it, and it holds the last character of the loop, not your character.

rows.when: The socket connected without a `secret` query (`player` is `undefined`), or `name` is missing.
`G.classes[player.type].rewards` is `undefined` (every class in G version 17478). Reading `[name]` on it throws, and the wrapper adds 16 call-cost.

confirm.note: Unreachable while no class in G has `rewards`
